summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares on 23 April 2026. It purchased 7,542,332 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 98.8528 pence per share, with prices ranging from 98.1600 to 99.2600 pence. The purchases were made through Goldman Sachs International as broker under the existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled. This ongoing capital return programme reduces outstanding shares and returns cash to shareholders. Watch for future buyback updates and execution pace.
